label.zh: 脂质间距（头部半径的倍数）

doc.zh: [{at: 0–1 沿膜弧长, width_mm: 跨膜部分总宽}]：这些位置给跨膜蛋白让位——蛋白两侧的磷脂贴住杆（头部圆心离杆缘 1 个头半径加 1/4 间距），窗口之间的每一段重新均匀排布；一般由宿主按嵌入关系算出回填。
doc.en: [{at: 0-1 along the membrane, width_mm: total transmembrane width}]: a window for a transmembrane protein - lipids hug the rod on both sides (head centre one radius plus a quarter pitch from the rod edge) and every segment between windows is re-spaced evenly; normally filled in by the host from the embed relation.

style_hint.zh: 建议样式：头部填浅暖色（如 #F3DCC0）、描边深棕；膜的描边（0.6 pt）比蛋白（0.85 pt）细，让膜退到蛋白后面。尾是细线。疏水核心的极浅暖色底带由宿主随膜另放一个对象，不在这里。不用渐变。
style_hint.en: Suggested style: light warm fill (e.g. #F3DCC0) on the heads with a dark brown outline; the membrane outline (0.6 pt) is thinner than the protein outline (0.85 pt) so it recedes. Tails are thin lines. The pale hydrophobic-core band is a separate object the host places with the membrane. No gradients.

style_hint.zh: 建议样式：各结构域填浅蓝灰（如 #D4DDE6）、描边深石板色，描边 0.85 pt（比膜的 0.6 pt 粗）；所有子路径同一描边，二聚体的两个单体用同一种颜色。不用渐变。
style_hint.en: Suggested style: light blue-grey fill (e.g. #D4DDE6) with a deep slate outline, 0.85 pt versus the membrane's 0.6 pt; one colour for both monomers. No gradients.
